SELECT id, room_no AS roomNo, physical_status AS physicalStatus FROM room WHERE room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT i.id, i.total_rooms AS totalRooms, i.booked_rooms AS bookedRooms, i.checked_in_rooms AS checkedInRooms, i.available_rooms AS availableRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND d.is_deleted = 0) AS detailCount FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND i.stay_date = #{stayDate} AND i.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_type_inventory (room_type_id, stay_date, total_rooms, booked_rooms, checked_in_rooms, available_rooms) VALUES (#{roomTypeId}, #{stayDate}, #{totalRooms}, 0, 0, #{availableRooms})

INSERT INTO room_inventory_detail (inventory_id, room_type_id, room_id, room_no, status, is_occupied) VALUES
(#{inventoryId}, #{roomTypeId}, #{room.id}, #{room.roomNo}, 'ACTIVE''OUT_OF_SERVICE', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM room_type WHERE id=#{roomTypeId} AND is_deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_order WHERE room_type_id=#{roomTypeId} AND DATE(planned_checkin_time) <= #{stayDate} AND DATE(planned_checkout_time) > #{stayDate}

SELECT i.is_deleted=0 AND i.total_rooms=i.booked_rooms+i.checked_in_rooms+i.available_rooms AND i.total_rooms=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id=i.id AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.is_deleted=0) AND i.checked_in_rooms=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id=i.id AND d.is_occupied=1 AND d.is_deleted=0) AND i.booked_rooms=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.lock_room_count),0) FROM inventory_lock_record l WHERE l.inventory_id=i.id AND l.lock_status='locked' AND l.is_deleted=0) AND i.checked_in_rooms=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.lock_room_count),0) FROM inventory_lock_record l WHERE l.inventory_id=i.id AND l.lock_status='release' AND l.is_deleted=0) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id=i.id)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE r.room_type_id=i.room_type_id AND r.is_deleted=0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_inventory_detail d LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id=d.room_id LEFT JOIN checkin_record c ON c.id=d.checkin_record_id WHERE d.inventory_id=i.id AND (d.is_deleted!=0 OR r.id IS NULL OR r.is_deleted!=0 OR d.room_type_id!=i.room_type_id OR r.room_type_id!=i.room_type_id OR d.room_no!=r.room_no OR d.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','OUT_OF_SERVICE') OR d.is_occupied NOT IN (0,1) OR (d.is_occupied=0 AND d.checkin_record_id IS NOT NULL) OR (d.is_occupied=1 AND (d.status!='ACTIVE' OR c.id IS NULL OR c.is_deleted!=0 OR c.room_id!=d.room_id OR c.room_type_id!=i.room_type_id OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_lock_record cl WHERE cl.order_id=c.order_id AND cl.inventory_id=i.id AND cl.lock_status='release' AND cl.is_deleted=0))))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_lock_record l LEFT JOIN booking_order o ON o.id=l.order_id WHERE l.inventory_id=i.id AND (l.is_deleted!=0 OR o.id IS NULL OR o.is_deleted!=0 OR o.room_type_id!=i.room_type_id OR l.lock_room_count!=o.room_count OR i.stay_date < DATE(o.planned_checkin_time) OR i.stay_date >= DATE(o.planned_checkout_time) OR l.lock_status!=CASE o.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'locked' WHEN 'CHECKED_IN' THEN 'release' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'cancel' ELSE 'invalid' END)) FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.id=#{inventoryId}
